item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Kaufpreise für Wohnimmobilien in Deutschland steigen einer Studie zufolge langsamer als im europäischen Durchschnitt. Seit März 2025 legten die Angebotspreise hierzulande um 2,5 Prozent zu, während der Anstieg im europäischen Mittel bei 6,6 Prozent lag, wie das Leibniz-Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung Halle (IWH) am Mittwoch mitteilte. Für seinen erstmals veröffentlichten European Real Estate Index hat das IWH monatlich 43 Millionen Angebote auf Online-Immobilienportalen in 1154 europäischen Regionen analysiert. Die Daten sollen Entwicklungen auf den Immobilienmärkten früher sichtbar machen als amtliche Statistiken, die auf tatsächlich erfolgten Transaktionen beruhen. "Angebotspreise sind nicht dasselbe wie die tatsächlich gezahlten Kaufpreise", sagte IWH-Vizepräsident Michael Koetter. "Sie zeigen jedoch früh und auf kleiner regionaler Ebene, wo Wohnen beispielsweise besonders teuer ist und wie sich Märkte auseinanderentwickeln." Gerade weil nationale Durchschnittswerte große lokale Unterschiede verdecken könnten, eröffne der Index neue Möglichkeiten für Forschung und wirtschaftspolitische Analysen, so Koetter weiter. Die Entwicklung der Immobilienpreise ist für die gesamte Volkswirtschaft von großer Bedeutung, betonten die Forscher. Wohnimmobilien machen den Angaben zufolge je nach Gruppe zwischen rund 50 und 72 Prozent des Nettovermögens privater Haushalte aus. Zugleich entfielen im Jahr 2022 fast 40 Prozent der Kredite und Forderungen von Banken im Euroraum auf diesen Sektor. "Immobilienpreise berühren Vermögen, Kreditversorgung und Finanzstabilität zugleich", sagte IWH-Präsident Reint Gropp. Der neue Index schaffe eine Datengrundlage, mit der regionale Entwicklungen früher erkannt und politische Maßnahmen besser gestaltet werden könnten, fügte Gropp hinzu.

item.title: Prezzi stabili, trader valutano rischi offerta
item.description: I prezzi del greggio rimangono pressoché invariati dopo avere raggiunto i massimi da oltre un mese nella prima parte della seduta, mentre gli operatori valutano il rischio di interruzioni della fornitura a seguito di attacchi lanciati durante la notte da Stati Uniti e Iran, a fronte dei segnali che le forniture di greggio continuano ad arrivare sul mercato.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I prezzi del greggio rimangono pressoché invariati dopo avere raggiunto i massimi da oltre un mese nella prima parte della seduta, mentre gli operatori valutano il rischio di interruzioni della fornitura a seguito di attacchi lanciati durante la notte da Stati Uniti e Iran, a fronte dei segnali che le forniture di greggio continuano ad arrivare sul mercato. ** Intorno alle 10.40 i futures sul Brent sono poco mossi a 94,7 dollari il barile, mentre i futures sul West Texas Intermediate perdono lo 0,17% a 90,07 dollari. ** In precedenza, il Brent e il West Texas Intermediate avevano toccato i massimi dal 24 luglio, rispettivamente a 97,04 dollari e 92,29 dollari il barile. ** "Un annuncio sul raggiungimento di un accordo, o di progressi in tal senso, potrebbe far crollare i prezzi, mentre qualsiasi escalation minerebbe ulteriormente le prospettive di un accordo di pace. Ecco perché il petrolio rimane altamente volatile, con un potenziale movimento di 5 dollari in entrambe le direzioni in base a nuovi sviluppi", ha detto Ole Hansen, responsabile della strategia sulle materie prime di Saxo Bank. ** Ieri Usa e Iran sono tornati sul piede di guerra dopo il maggiore scontro a fuoco delle ultime settimane, con Washington che ha minacciato attacchi ancora più devastanti. Il Corpo delle Guardie rivoluzionarie islamiche ha affermato che gli attacchi Usa limiterebbero ulteriormente il traffico attraverso lo Stretto di Hormuz. ** Tuttavia, ieri il segretario all’Energia degli Stati Uniti Chris Wright ha riferito che lunedì hanno attraversato lo Stretto di Hormuz ben 17 milioni di barili di greggio, sottolineando che si è trattato del livello più alto da quando la guerra con l’Iran ha ridotto i flussi sulla rotta. ** Passando a un altro fronte, nella notte la Russia ha sferrato un "massiccio" attacco con missili e droni contro le infrastrutture energetiche nella regione meridionale ucraina di Odessa, come riferito dall’operatore del sistema di trasmissione Ukrenergo.

item.title: MLB roundup: Contributions from newcomers carry Nationals past Braves
item.description: Yohandy Morales singled, doubled and homered in his major league debut, Jared Simpson pitched three scoreless innings for the win in his big-league debut, and the Washington Nationals beat the visiting Atlanta Braves 9-5 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Yohandy Morales singled, doubled and homered in his major league debut, Jared Simpson pitched three scoreless innings for the win in his big-league debut, and the Washington Nationals beat the visiting Atlanta Braves 9-5 on Tuesday. CJ Abrams, back in the Washington lineup after getting scratched Monday night due to back soreness, had two hits and drove in two runs. Brady House knocked in three runs for the Nationals, who have won five of six. Morales, a 24-year-old infielder, went 3-for-5 while serving as the designated hitter. Simpson (1-0), a 26-year-old left-hander, did not allow a hit or a walk while striking out three. Ozzie Albies and Michael Harris II homered, but the Braves took their second straight loss after winning seven in a row. AJ Smith-Shawver (0-1) was tagged for five runs on six hits in four innings. Guardians 6, Blue Jays 1 Gavin Williams struck out a career-best 13 over seven strong innings and was supported by three homers as Cleveland topped visiting Toronto. Williams (13-7) held the Blue Jays to one unearned run on two hits as Cleveland grew its lead over Toronto to 2 1/2 games in a tight race for the third American League wild card. Patrick Bailey, Angel Genao and Angel Martinez each socked a two-run homer for the Guardians. Spencer Arrighetti (7-8) surrendered two runs on two hits in 3 2/3 innings of relief for the Blue Jays. Toronto, which had won four of its previous five games, managed only three hits. Yankees 7, Angels 3 Spencer Jones and Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit back-to-back home runs during a three-run first inning and Cody Bellinger went 3-for-5 with two runs, propelling New York to a victory over Los Angeles in Anaheim, Calif. Yankees starter Gerrit Cole (8-7) allowed three runs on eight hits in 5 1/3 innings. New York clubbed 14 hits while evening the three-game series at a game apiece. Christian Moore had a two-run triple and Wade Meckler went 3-for-4 with an RBI for the Angels, who lost for the eighth time in nine games. Grayson Rodriguez (4-6) gave up four runs on seven hits in six innings. Cardinals 13, Dodgers 8 Thomas Saggese hit two home runs and St. Louis tied its season high with five long balls while prevailing at Los Angeles. Jordan Walker, Ramon Urias and Joshua Baez added home runs and Leo Bernal had a two-run single in his major league debut for the Cardinals. Michael McGreevy (6-9) wobbled through five innings, allowing four runs on five hits. Mookie Betts had two doubles and drove in four runs for the Dodgers, who lost for the fifth time in seven games. Eric Lauer (8-7) yielded seven runs on eight hits in three innings. Will Smith, back from the injured list, went 1-for-5 with two RBIs. Rockies 4, Orioles 2 TJ Rumfield hit a tiebreaking homer in the seventh inning and Colorado beat Baltimore in Denver, snapping a franchise-worst 10-game home losing streak. Adael Amador also went deep and singled and Jake McCarthy and Brett Sullivan had two hits each for the Rockies. Jaden Hill (1-3) pitched a scoreless inning of relief, and Jordan Romano picked up his 14th save by throwing a 1-2-3 ninth. Jackson Holliday homered among his three hits for the Orioles, whose four-game winning streak ended. Baltimore reliever Luis De Leon (0-1) served up Rumfield's homer. Phillies 7, Diamondbacks 1 Bryce Harper had four singles and an RBI, Jesus Luzardo continued his road dominance, and Philadelphia beat Arizona in Phoenix for its sixth consecutive win. Luzardo (13-5) gave up one run and six hits in 6 2/3 innings. He is 9-0 with a 1.76 ERA in 15 starts away from home this season. The left-hander has won his past four decisions and is 10-1 since May 25. Harper, who also drew a walk, has reached base in a career-high 34 straight games. Jordan Lawlar went 2-for-3 with a homer for the D-backs, who have lost three in a row and have scored two or fewer runs in six of their past nine games. They are 0-for-13 with runners in scoring position through the first two games of the three-game series. Reds 4, Padres 3 Jose Trevino singled home the go-ahead run with a bases-loaded single in the eighth to lead Cincinnati past visiting San Diego. Elly De La Cruz opened the game-winning rally with a walk against reliever Adrian Morejon (9-3). Sal Stewart followed with a single to center to put runners at the corners. After a groundout and an intentional walk to the light-hitting Matt McLain to load the bases, Trevino delivered the tiebreaking hit to center. Rookie Juan Brito, making his Reds debut, followed Trevino with a sacrifice fly to left for an insurance run. Fernando Tatis Jr. homered twice for the Padres, who lost for the fourth time in five games. Rays 6, Mets 2 Freddy Peralta spun six spectacular innings to beat his former club and Yandy Diaz homered in Tampa Bay's three-run sixth as the Rays beat New York in St. Petersburg, Fla. Following a slow start as the Mets scored and notched three hits in the first, Peralta (7-11) settled in, tossing five hitless frames and retiring his last 13 batters. The Rays acquired Peralta from the Mets for three prospects at the trade deadline. Francisco Lindor led off the game with a home run and had both RBIs for the Mets. Mariners 9, Red Sox 6 Lazaro Montes homered in his major league debut for visiting Seattle, which scored in each of the first five innings en route to a win over Boston. All nine starters produced at least one hit for the Mariners, who snapped a five-game skid with a 14-hit attack. Randy Arozarena contributed a three-run homer, and Dominic Canzone also went deep. The early run support was more than enough for Bryan Woo (10-9), who allowed two runs (one earned) on five hits. Mickey Gasper hit his seventh homer in his past 13 major league games for Boston. Jedixson Paez (0-1), recalled from Triple-A Worcester to make his first major league start and Red Sox debut, was tagged for eight runs on 10 hits in 3 2/3 innings. Pirates 13, Giants 12 Brandon Lowe raced home from third base on a throwing error by substitute third baseman Osleivis Basabe with two outs in the bottom of the ninth inning, allowing Pittsburgh, after blowing a six-run lead, to outlast visiting San Francisco. Lowe led off the ninth against the fifth Giants pitcher, Carson Seymour (0-1), with his fourth hit of the game, a single, then advanced a base at a time on a Nick Gonzales single and an Oneil Cruz infield out. Cruz joined Lowe with a four-hit night and had a career-high-tying four RBIs for the Pirates, who won their third in a row. Turner Hill had four hits and Drew Cavanaugh three for the Giants, who were attempting to win a third game in three days at three different locations. Marlins 6, Royals 3 Graham Pauley hit a two-run homer and a two-run triple while Tyler Phillips (4-6) allowed one hit over five scoreless innings as Miami won at Kansas City. Pauley was recalled from Triple-A Jacksonville as major league rosters were expanded, and he recorded a career-high four RBIs. Kyle Stowers also homered for the Marlins, who had just dropped three of four at Washington. Royals starter Randy Dobnak (2-3) was charged with a season-high six runs on seven hits over six-plus innings. Nick Loftin homered, but Kansas City's season-best seven-game home winning streak ended. Rangers 8, Athletics 5 Brandon Nimmo had four hits and five RBIs as Texas topped the Athletics in Arlington, Texas. Corey Seager doubled twice and scored three runs for the Rangers, who have won three in a row. MacKenzie Gore (8-10) allowed one run and five hits in 5 1/3 innings, and Jacob Latz struck out both batters he faced for his 28th save. Jeff McNeil homered and doubled for the A's, who have lost five in a row. Brady Basso (0-2) went 2 1/3 innings, allowing two runs and four hits. Twins 15, Tigers 2 Royce Lewis went 3-for-4 and belted a three-run homer in a 10-run sixth inning as Minnesota smashed Detroit in Minneapolis. The Twins have outscored the Tigers 26-3 in the first two games of the three-game series, with Kody Clemens and Ryan Jeffers homering in each contest. Jeffers has three long balls in the series. Connor Prielipp (4-7) permitted three hits in five scoreless innings as Minnesota's bulk reliever. The Tigers have lost seven straight road games and three games in a row overall. Troy Melton (7-4) allowed six hits and seven runs, five earned, in 5 1/3 innings. Brewers 9, Cubs 4 Christian Yelich and Joey Ortiz each hit two-run homers as visiting Milwaukee evened its four-game series against Chicago. Jackson Chourio, Brice Turang, William Contreras and Ortiz each had two hits for the Brewers, who bounced back from a 17-3 loss in the series opener. Robert Gasser gave up three runs (two earned) over 4 1/3 innings. The Brewers outhit Chicago 13-6 and moved eight games ahead of the second-place Cubs in the National League Central. Cubs starter Matthew Boyd allowed three runs on seven hits over 5 1/3 innings. White Sox 5, Astros 1 Sean Burke threw 5 2/3 shutout innings as visiting Chicago defeated Houston, leaving each team with one win to begin a four-game series between division leaders. Colson Montgomery produced his second multi-hit game in as many nights for the White Sox. Burke (8-6) recorded his fifth scoreless outing of the season, permitting just one hit. The Astros fell for the seventh time in their past 10 home games. Ronel Blanco, recalled to make his first major league appearance since Aug. 15, labored but still tossed four shutout innings. Kai-Wei Teng (5-7) permitted three runs in two innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Shein shares slide more than 5% on second day of Hong Kong trading
item.description: Shares of online fast-fashion retailer Shein fell more than 5% on Wednesday, a day after a lacklustre debut session following a long-awaited initial public offering.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares of online fast-fashion retailer Shein (0625.HK) fell more than 5% on Wednesday, a day after a lacklustre debut session following a long-awaited initial public offering. The stock tumbled as much as 10% on Tuesday but recovered to close to its HK$48.56 issuance price. On Wednesday, the stock closed at HK$46 on its second day of trading in Hong Kong, while the city's Hang Seng Index (.HSI) closed flat. Shein's share price rallied late Tuesday and its rebound was the result of so-called stabilisation measures which can be applied to large listings to avoid sharp declines on a debut day, according to a source and analysts. Shein raised $1.7 billion in its IPO which valued the firm at $26.5 billion, nearly a quarter of its peak of nearly $100 billion in 2022. Higher import duties in key markets, growing regulatory risks and intensified competition from rivals are hampering Shein's growth prospects, investors and analysts said. "Shein's weak performance reflects investors reassessing a growth story that has become harder to underwrite," said Brandon Ho, head of investment advisory for Singapore at Arta Finance. "Revenue growth has slowed over the past few years and margins are under pressure, while higher tariffs and customs costs in the U.S. and EU are weakening the economics of its low-cost cross-border model.

item.title: Cuatro muertos y diez heridos tras un atropello en un acto progubernamental en Irán
item.description: Un vehículo arrolló durante la noche a un grupo de simpatizantes del Gobierno y las Fuerzas Armadas de Irán en la ciudad de Mashhad, al noreste del país, causando la muerte de cuatro personas y dejando más de diez heridos, informaron este miércoles varios medios de comunicación iraníes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un vehículo arrolló durante la noche a un grupo de simpatizantes del Gobierno y las Fuerzas Armadas de Irán en la ciudad de Mashhad, al noreste del país, causando la muerte de cuatro personas y dejando más de diez heridos, informaron este miércoles varios medios de comunicación iraníes. Según Noor News, basándose en la información de Mohsen Mousa-Abadi, jefe de la policía de tráfico de la provincia de Khorasán Razaví, un automóvil que circulaba a gran velocidad chocó primero contra otro vehículo, perdió el control y, tras embestir las barreras de seguridad y las señales de tráfico, se desvió hacia la multitud. El conductor fue detenido. "El conductor es un hombre de unos 35 años y tiene un permiso de conducir condicional, con restricciones médicas. Esta persona no ve por el ojo izquierdo y conducía únicamente con el ojo derecho", dijo un responsable anónimo de la policía de tráfico, según se citó en un artículo posterior del medio de comunicación judicial Mizan. Mizan añadió que el accidente no fue intencionado ni tuvo relación con cuestiones de seguridad.

item.title: Corea del Sur pide que se establezcan las condiciones para el diálogo entre Washington y Pionyang
item.description: El presidente surcoreano, Lee Jae-myung, dijo el miércoles que deben crearse las condiciones necesarias para reanudar el diálogo entre Estados Unidos y Corea del Norte, informó la Casa Azul, la sede presidencial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente surcoreano, Lee Jae-myung, dijo el miércoles que deben crearse las condiciones necesarias para reanudar el diálogo entre Estados Unidos y Corea del Norte, informó la Casa Azul, la sede presidencial. Lee, en su intervención en una reunión de asesores extranjeros sobre la paz en la Península de Corea, señaló además que el sistema de armisticio en la Península de Corea debería transformarse en un sistema de paz basado en la cooperación y la prosperidad. "Debemos cambiar la desafortunada realidad en la que Corea del Norte y Corea del Sur utilizan su fuerza únicamente para enfrentarse entre sí", dijo Lee, según citó la Casa Azul. Las dos Coreas siguen técnicamente en guerra, ya que su conflicto de 1950-1953 terminó con un armisticio en lugar de un tratado de paz. Lee también dijo que Corea del Sur debería cumplir con su responsabilidad en favor de la paz en la península coreana mediante la recuperación del control operativo en tiempo de guerra de manos de Estados Unidos, algo que se ha comprometido a llevar a cabo antes de que finalice su mandato en 2030. Lee ha impulsado de forma constante el diálogo con Corea del Norte desde que asumió el cargo, a pesar de que Pionyang haya calificado a Corea del Sur de Estado hostil y haya cerrado los canales de comunicación. Corea del Norte también ha seguido presentando a Estados Unidos como un país hostil, a pesar de los esfuerzos del presidente Donald Trump por reactivar la diplomacia y de su llamamiento del mes pasado a reducir las maniobras militares conjuntas de Estados Unidos con Corea del Sur, que Pionyang lleva mucho tiempo denunciando como ensayos para una invasión. La agencia de inteligencia de Corea del Sur ha señalado que Corea del Norte y Estados Unidos están dando señales de reanudar el diálogo, aunque no se han confirmado contactos concretos, afirmaron el martes varios parlamentarios en Seúl.

item.title: Indian rupee to get support in coming months from RBI dollar sales: Reuters poll
item.description: The Indian rupee will hold near current weak levels, a Reuters poll of strategists found, although foreign currency deposits from non-resident Indians give the Reserve Bank of India further scope to intervene to limit depreciation.
item.dc:creator: Pranoy Krishna
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee will hold near current weak levels, a Reuters poll of strategists found, although foreign currency deposits from non-resident Indians give the Reserve Bank of India further scope to intervene to limit depreciation. [USN:L4N42G1HH TEXT:"Measures"] the RBI announced in June to attract foreign capital lifted its foreign exchange reserves to a [USN:L4N44P0W1 TEXT:"record"] of more than $729 billion in the week to August 21. That places the onus on the RBI to take further action as the partially convertible rupee is down over 5% against the dollar for the year. Foreign investors have sold more than a net $24 billion of Indian equities so far this year despite [USN:L4N44S0T4 TEXT:"stronger-than-expected"] economic growth of 7.8% in the last quarter. Global uncertainty has weighed generally on emerging market currencies, while the U.S. dollar looks set to maintain a holding pattern against most currencies in the coming months, analysts say. SUSTAINED BEARISH OUTLOOK According to the median forecast of 35 strategists polled between August 31 and September 2, India's rupee was forecast to trade near current levels at 95.49 per dollar in three months and 95.89 by end-February. A year from now, the survey expected the outlook would become more bearish, with the rupee forecast to weaken nearly 2% from current levels to 96.78 per dollar, close to a record low. "Dollar reserves have given the RBI comfort it can sell more in the market. So they will not allow the rupee to depreciate in a big way, that is for sure. 95.50 or 95.75 could become a cap for the next three to six months," said Anil Bhansali, head of treasury at Finrex Treasury Advisors. Bhansali said the economic growth figure in theory should have attracted more money into equities in India, but that had not happened. A separate Reuters poll published last week showed equity analysts had [USN:L6N44N0JB TEXT:"lowered"] their outlook again for Indian stocks as foreign funds sought cheaper or more technology-focused markets elsewhere in Asia. "That disconnect between the growth and the stock market should continue in the coming months," Bhansali said. While the RBI's large FX reserves can curb near-term rupee volatility, a persistent shortfall in foreign direct investment is likely to keep the rupee under pressure. "Gone are the days when we can account for $35 billion to $40 billion of FDI. They will more be in the region of $5 billion to $10 billion," said Indranil Pan, chief economist at Yes Bank. ([USN:L6N44U08H TEXT:"Other stories"] from the September Reuters foreign exchange poll)

item.title: CON O ¿Qué opciones de represalias tiene Irán tras reanudarse la guerra abierta con EEUU?
item.description: Estados Unidos lanzó una nueva oleada de ataques contra Irán a última hora del martes, tras seis meses de estancamiento en el conflicto, lo que provocó que Irán lanzara misiles contra supuestos "activos estadounidenses" en Jordania, Baréin, Kuwait e Irak.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos lanzó una nueva oleada de ataques contra Irán a última hora del martes, tras seis meses de estancamiento en el conflicto, lo que provocó que Irán lanzara misiles contra supuestos "activos estadounidenses" en Jordania, Baréin, Kuwait e Irak. A continuación se exponen otras formas en las que Irán podría tomar represalias si el conflicto sigue escalando o si se intensifica la campaña estadounidense para asfixiar la economía iraní. IRÁN PODRÍA AMPLIAR SUS ATAQUES A OTROS ESTADOS DEL GOLFO PÉRSICO Irán ha atacado repetidamente a sus vecinos en respuesta a los ataques estadounidenses y ha amenazado con tomar represalias contra cualquiera que participe en los esfuerzos de EEUU por estrangular la economía del país con una fuerza "sísmica". Ha lanzado ataques repetidamente contra los Estados del golfo Pérsico y Jordania desde que comenzó la guerra el 28 de febrero, centrándose principalmente en las bases estadounidenses, pero también en infraestructuras energéticas y otros objetivos. Cualquier intensificación de los ataques dirigidos contra instalaciones de extracción de petróleo o gas podría hacer subir aún más los precios de la energía, lo que infligiría un daño político al Gobierno de Trump y podría ser más difícil de revertir que los ataques contra el transporte marítimo. Atacar las centrales eléctricas y las plantas desalinizadoras de agua en esta región cálida y árida también supondría un riesgo importante para las monarquías del golfo Pérsico alineadas con EEUU, que funcionan como importantes centros financieros para la economía mundial. IRÁN PODRÍA IMPEDIR QUE SALGA MÁS PETRÓLEO DE ORIENTE MEDIO Mohsen Rezaei, exjefe de la Guardia Revolucionaria y secretario del Consejo Supremo de Seguridad Nacional de Irán, ha amenazado con paralizar las exportaciones de petróleo —una de las principales estrategias de Teherán a lo largo del conflicto—. Según Rezaei, si la guerra económica continúa, no se exportará ni una sola gota de petróleo a través del estrecho de Ormuz ni desde ningún punto del golfo Pérsico. Los ataques y amenazas iraníes a la navegación ya han paralizado la mayor parte del tráfico por el estrecho de Ormuz, cerrando en gran medida una vía navegable que, antes del conflicto, transportaba alrededor de una quinta parte de la energía mundial. Aunque algunos petroleros han atravesado el estrecho en las últimas semanas, los volúmenes siguen siendo muy bajos. Los ataques con misiles, drones o lanchas rápidas contra los petroleros que intentan salir del golfo Pérsico han provocado repetidas subidas de los precios del petróleo durante los seis meses que lleva el conflicto. Mientras tanto, los aliados hutíes de Teherán han restringido la navegación por el mar Rojo con ataques y amenazas de bloquear todo el tráfico marítimo de Arabia Saudita, que transporta crudo a Asia a través del estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, pasando por el bastión yemení del grupo. Aunque en un principio los ataques solo detuvieron a algunos buques —más de la mitad seguían pasando a mediados de agosto—, la situación resulta complicada para los transportistas, ya que las navieras chinas están desviando ahora sus rutas para evitar Bab el-Mandeb, según fuentes del sector. Nuevos ataques, como el que tuvo como objetivo un buque frente a la principal terminal petrolera saudita del mar Rojo, en Yanbu, la semana pasada, o un ataque con drones cerca del canal de Suez a principios de agosto, podrían aumentar los niveles de inquietud en el mercado petrolero y los precios del crudo. IRÁN PODRÍA ATACAR DIRECTAMENTE A LOS PAÍSES OCCIDENTALES Aunque los países occidentales se encuentran fuera del alcance de las principales armas de Irán, la Guardia Revolucionaria siempre ha estado dispuesta a buscar formas alternativas de ataque. Reino Unido ha afirmado que piratas informáticos vinculados a Irán paralizaron una pequeña central eléctrica, mientras que fuentes estadounidenses señalaron que es probable que Teherán esté detrás de los ciberataques contra plantas de tratamiento de agua en Minnesota. Irán no se ha pronunciado sobre estas acusaciones. Los servicios de seguridad occidentales también han acusado a Irán de reclutar a personas locales para llevar a cabo atentados o intentos de asesinato en Occidente. Irán lo ha negado.

item.title: Too weak, too strict: India's food warning labels draw fire from all sides
item.description: Activists say many items will escape scrutiny while companies warn that the strict thresholds will put red flags on a wide range of products.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian government is facing fierce opposition on proposed food warning labels from both health experts and food giants - activists say many items will escape scrutiny while companies warn that the strict thresholds will put red flags on a wide range of products. In a setback to India's over $100 billion packaged food industry, which has long opposed any form of [USN:FWN44P0U2 TEXT:"front-of-pack warnings"], the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) last week proposed a red-coloured hexagonal label for products that exceed limits in at least two of three nutrients - added sugar, salt or saturated fat. The proposal came amid intense public anger and debate after Reuters reported that India's government had yielded [USN:L6N44H08J TEXT:"to industry lobbying"] in March when Coca-Cola and groups backing Nestle and PepsiCo opposed having warning labels on the front of food and drinks packaging. For global health safety experts, India's proposed two-nutrient threshold is however a key concern because products that are high in just one of the three flagged nutrients will effectively escape scrutiny. "It will be meaningless. No other country uses the double nutrient approach," said Barry Popkin, a professor in the Department of Nutrition at UNC Gillings School of Global Public Health. "Every country with warning labels has a separate label with large fonts for each key nutrient." Globally, researchers say warning labels have benefited public health, and India's Supreme Court has called for their implementation while hearing pleas from activists. Chile's 2016 food labelling law, which puts separate black octagons on a pack for each nutrient that is excessive, was followed by a 23.7% decline in purchases of sugary drinks in the 18 months after it kicked in, according to a study in the journal PLOS Medicine. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government this year flagged obesity concerns, saying retail sales of ultra-processed food increased 40 times between 2006 and 2019 to $38 billion. India had 180 million adults who were overweight or obese in 2021, projected to rise to 450 million by 2050, according to a study published in The Lancet. ACTIVISTS PROTEST LOOPHOLES IN PROPOSAL The FSSAI has presented the labelling proposal to the Supreme Court and judges will decide on its merits during a hearing scheduled for September 10, a government source told Reuters when asked about health experts' concerns. The health group that challenged New Delhi in court, 3S And Our Health, has already prepared a draft submission for the judges challenging the proposal. Seen by Reuters, it says there are many loopholes including an exemption granted to honey, jaggery and similar inherently sugar- or fat-rich foods, and it also flags the "two-nutrient threshold". Under the current proposal, a Kellogg's multigrain Chocos box in India, whose label shows it contains 27% added sugar by weight but has fat and salt within the proposal's limits, will potentially escape warnings. A spokesperson for Kellogg's owner Mars said the company supports "clear, science-based nutrition information" and will comply with Indian laws as and when they change. However, Mars added: "Ingredient requirements and local tastes vary regionally. We believe all foods can be part of a balanced diet." Unilever's India unit also said it was committed to compliance with Indian labelling rules and supports measures to help consumers make informed choices. Nestle (NESN.S) , PepsiCo (PEP.O) , Coca-Cola (KO.N) and Mondelez (MDLZ.O) did not respond to queries. INDUSTRY FEARS 'EVERYTHING WILL BE RED' The industry is also preparing to push back. Seven executives from Indian and foreign firms told Reuters they were extremely concerned, with one key issue being India is proposing a 100-gram benchmark to judge whether a product needs to be flagged, instead of going by a single serve. "Nobody consumes 100 grams of a pickle or ketchup," said a senior executive, who said industry will press the FSSAI to consider per serve calculations instead, like the [USN:L4N3OA17D TEXT:"U.S. FDA has mooted"]. The other big issue for major food companies is thresholds - India is proposing a red warning if added sugar is in excess of 3% of solid products by weight, and fat in excess of 4.2% - stricter than many foreign markets. A CEO of an Indian firm said: "Everything will be red." Indians are known to have a sweet tooth and love their savoury snacks, called namkeen. India's Federation of Sweets and Namkeen Manufacturers said its 5,000 members are "deeply concerned" because sugar, salt and fat are integral to many traditional products, and a consumer may just be eating a tiny piece of mithai (Indian sweet) at a time. "A substantial majority of packaged traditional sweets and namkeen could attract warnings," said the federation's director general Firoz Naqvi. "It could negatively affect consumer perception and demand."

item.title: Paredes duda sobre su futuro en la selección argentina tras sanción y salida de Messi
item.description: El centrocampista Leandro Paredes dijo que le resultará difícil seguir jugando con la selección de fútbol de Argentina tras recibir una sanción de diez partidos por su participación en una trifulca tras la derrota en la final del Mundial ante España.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El centrocampista Leandro Paredes dijo que le resultará difícil seguir jugando con la selección de fútbol de Argentina tras recibir [USN:L6N44I0UQ TEXT:"una sanción"] de diez partidos por su participación en una trifulca tras la derrota en la final del Mundial ante España. El jugador, de 32 años, también señaló que la retirada de Lionel Messi de la selección era otro motivo por el que tendría que plantearse su futuro con la selección nacional. Paredes recibió la sanción en agosto, semanas después de que se desatara un altercado al sonar el pitido final, cuando empujó al suelo al centrocampista español Gavi mientras los suplentes de los campeones se abalanzaban sobre el terreno de juego para celebrar la victoria. Paredes enfrentó tres cargos por agresión, mientras que su compañero Nahuel Molina tenía dos. Ambos jugadores fueron además multados con 90.000 dólares. "Va a ser difícil que yo siga en la selección", declaró Paredes a medios argentinos el martes. "Por la suspensión (...), por la decisión de Leo... Va a ser difícil que siga todo funcionando igual." "No lo hablé con el entrenador (Lionel Scaloni), pero lo hablaremos y veremos la decisión que tome." Paredes dijo que la ausencia de Messi en la selección se notaría mucho. "El legado de él va a quedar para siempre por lo que dejó, por no rendirse nunca y por demostrar que los sueños se sufren, se persiguen y al final se cumplen", añadió Paredes. "Habíamos hablado en los últimos días del Mundial que seguramente la final era su último partido, pero igual no estábamos preparados para eso por lo que significa él para nosotros."

item.title: Italia, prezzi produzione industria accelerano su anno a luglio - Istat
item.description: I prezzi alla produzione dell'industria italiana a luglio sono tornati a crescere su mese (+2,4%) e hanno subìto una decisa accelerazione tendenziale (+7,8%) per via dei marcati rialzi dei prezzi della componente energetica sul mercato interno, secondo i dati diffusi stamani da Istat.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I prezzi alla produzione dell'industria italiana a luglio sono tornati a crescere su mese (+2,4%) e hanno subìto una decisa accelerazione tendenziale (+7,8%) per via dei marcati rialzi dei prezzi della componente energetica sul mercato interno, secondo i dati diffusi stamani da Istat. A giugno si era registrata una variazione congiunturale nulla e un rallentamento tendenziale al 5,8%. Sul mercato interno i prezzi crescono del 3% rispetto a giugno e del 9,3% su base annua (da +6,8% del mese precedente). Sul mercato estero i prezzi aumentano dello 0,6% su base mensile e del 3,6% su base annua. Al netto della componente energetica, rileva Istat, "la crescita dei prezzi è molto più contenuta su base sia congiunturale (+0,3%) sia tendenziale (+3,3% dal +2,9% di giugno)". Nel trimestre maggio-luglio, rispetto al precedente, i prezzi alla produzione dell’industria crescono del 2,2% (+2,4% mercato interno, +1,5% mercato estero). [USN:L8N44S1C0 TEXT:"A luglio l'indice Nic"] dei prezzi al consumo ha registrato aumenti dello 0,3% a livello congiunturale e del 2,9% su anno, con il tasso tendenziale balzato poi al 3,3% il mese scorso.

item.title: Nestlé cede divisione vitamine per 1 mld dlr
item.description: Nestlé ha comunicato che venderà i suoi principali marchi di integratori vitaminici alla società di private equity Yellow Wood Partners per 1 miliardo di dollari, nell'ambito di un rafforzamento strategico da parte del Ceo Philipp Navratil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nestlé ha comunicato che venderà i suoi principali marchi di integratori vitaminici alla società di private equity Yellow Wood Partners per 1 miliardo di dollari, nell'ambito di un rafforzamento strategico da parte del Ceo Philipp Navratil. Navratil, che ha assunto la guida di Nestlé esattamente un anno fa, ha ridotto l’esposizione dell’azienda ai marchi di gelato e acqua attraverso joint venture, snellendo il portafoglio del conglomerato svizzero alla ricerca di una crescita. La strategia è simile a quella adottata dai competitor nel settore dei beni di consumo Unilever (ULVR.L) e Reckitt (RKT.L) . La vendita della divisione di Nestlé dedicata a vitamine, minerali e integratori comprende sette marchi (Nature’s Bounty, Osteo Bi-Flex, Ester-C, Gard, Nuun, Puritan’s Pride e Sisu) oltre alla sua attività Usa di integratori a marchio privato, si legge in un comunicato di Nestlé. Tali marchi hanno generato ricavi pari a 1,2 miliardi di dollari nel 2025, ha precisato Nestlé. "Stiamo concentrando le nostre risorse dove abbiamo il vantaggio competitivo più forte", ha detto Navratil, aggiungendo che il settore mainstream delle vitamine, dei minerali e degli integratori "richiede un approccio diverso sotto una proprietà dedicata". L’operazione dovrebbe concludersi nella prima metà del 2027.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der schwedische Autobauer Volvo (VOLCARb.ST) hat von Juni bis August weniger Autos verkauft. Der Absatz fiel weltweit um 7,4 Prozent auf 148.239 Fahrzeuge, wie der zum chinesischen Geely (0175.HK) -Konzern gehörende Hersteller am Mittwoch mitteilte. Der Wandel zur Elektromobilität prägte den Absatz, E-Modelle inklusive Hybriden machten mehr als die Hälfte der Verkäufe aus. Während der Verkauf reiner E-Autos um 27 Prozent stieg, brach der Absatz von Hybridfahrzeugen und Verbrennern um 23 Prozent ein. Die Marktschwäche in China sowie eine schwache Nachfrage nach Elektro- und Plug-in-Hybridautos in den USA hätten belastet. Die Anleger reagierten enttäuscht: Die Titel gaben um rund drei Prozent nach.

item.title: BUZZ BORSA Lottomatica crolla dopo annuncio deal Cirsa, mercato colto di sorpresa
item.description: ** Crolla Lottomatica in Borsa dopo l'annuncio a sorpresa della fusione con la spagnola Cirsa , interamente basata su scambio azionario. L'operazione darà vita al secondo operatore globale del 'gaming', che sarà quotato sia a Milano sia a Madrid.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: ** Crolla Lottomatica (LTMC.MI) in Borsa dopo [USN:L8N44U090 TEXT:"l'annuncio a sorpresa"] della fusione con la spagnola Cirsa (CIRSA.MC) , interamente basata su scambio azionario. L'operazione darà vita al secondo operatore globale del 'gaming', che sarà quotato sia a Milano sia a Madrid. ** Intorno alle 10.20 le azioni Lottomatica segnano un calo del 9,7% circa a 22,39 euro. Il titolo è partito forte, toccando quota 24,38 euro, per poi ripiegare subito dopo l'avvio. I volumi sono già pari a circa 1 milione di pezzi a fronte di una media a 30 giorni sull'intera seduta di 677.000. ** Cirsa segna, invece, un rialzo di oltre il 15% a 15,7 euro. ** Un trader sottolinea che il mercato è rimasto sorpreso da questo cambio di strategia da parte di Lottomatica, "in un momento congiunturale, forse non favorevole a queste operazioni". Il titolo è partito forte perché "evidentemente qualcuno è entrato sulla scia dell'euforia", ha aggiunto. Tuttavia dopo questa fiammata, "sono scattate le prese di profitto". ** Dai broker i giudizi sono sostanzialmente positivi. Equita considera "l’operazione interessante, in quanto consente l’accesso a un mercato meno maturo come quello spagnolo, consolida definitivamente la posizione della società in Italia e genera chiare opportunità di sinergia senza compromettere un interessante rendimento per gli azionisti". ** Secondo Intermonte, "il debito resta sotto controllo nonostante la generosa remunerazione degli azionisti". ** Tuttavia il broker indica come elementi che possono influire sull'andamento del titolo "la limitata conoscenza di Cirsa e del mercato spagnolo, un possibile rischio overhang sulle azioni legato al 24% di Blackstone (BX.N) che ha un lock-up sulla vendita di soli tre mesi, l'esposizione di Cirsa verso i casinò (pari al 53% del proprio Ebitda) e i mercati nell'America Latina", e il via libera dei regolatori con il closing atteso nel secondo trimestre 2027.

Die Waffe habe eine Reichweite von bis zu 500 Kilometern. Sollte sich Berlin für eine Beschaffung entscheiden, wäre LORA die erste ballistische Rakete der Bundeswehr. Marine-Inspekteur Jan Christian Kaack sprach von einem Erfolg. "Für den Schutz Deutschlands und unserer Verbündeten markiert dieser Test ein neues Kapitel bei der Abschreckung und der maritimen Verteidigungsbereitschaft", erklärte er. Der Test erfolgte nur Stunden, nachdem Bundesinnenminister Alexander Dobrindt Russland als Verantwortlichen für den versuchten Anschlag auf dem Flughafen Leipzig genannt und Außenminister Johann Wadephul verschiedene Maßnahmen angekündigt hatte, darunter die Schließung des russischen Generalkonsulats in Bonn. Der Test ist Teil der Bemühungen Deutschlands und anderer westlicher Staaten, sich seit dem russischen Angriff auf die Ukraine verstärkt mit Langstreckenwaffen auszustatten. Bislang verfügt die Bundeswehr mit dem Marschflugkörper Taurus über eine Waffe mit einer Reichweite von mehr als 500 Kilometern. Ballistische Raketen sind jedoch deutlich schneller als Marschflugkörper. Deutschland arbeitet zudem an einer modernisierten Version des Taurus, deren Produktion 2029 beginnen soll. Derzeit hat die Bundeswehr rund 600 Taurus-Raketen im Bestand, die von Kampfjets aus abgefeuert werden.

item.title: El brote de ébola en RDC se ha cobrado más de 3.000 vidas
item.description: El número de fallecidos por el brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo ha superado los 3.000, según datos del Gobierno publicados este miércoles, mientras la peor epidemia de la historia del país sigue extendiéndose por el noreste.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El número de fallecidos por el brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo ha superado los 3.000, según datos del Gobierno publicados este miércoles, mientras la peor epidemia de la historia del país sigue extendiéndose por el noreste. El brote, causado por la subespecie de Bundibugyo del ébola, se ha convertido en el mayor y más mortífero de la historia de RDC tras superar a la epidemia de 2018-2020. Ahora solo es superado por el brote de África Occidental de 2014-2016, que infectó a más de 28.600 personas y causó la muerte de más de 11.000 en Guinea, Liberia y Sierra Leona. Las cifras del Gobierno indicaban que el número de fallecidos había ascendido a 3.007, mientras que los casos confirmados alcanzaban los 6.186. El brote se declaró oficialmente en la provincia de Ituri el 15 de mayo, aunque algunos responsables sanitarios y expertos afirman que podría haber comenzado ya en enero. Desde entonces se ha extendido a seis provincias, a pesar de los esfuerzos de las autoridades congoleñas, la Organización Mundial de la Salud y las organizaciones humanitarias por contenerlo. Expertos sanitarios señalan que la debilidad de los sistemas de vigilancia, la inseguridad y la resistencia de las comunidades han obstaculizado los esfuerzos por identificar y tratar a los pacientes de forma precoz. La Organización Mundial de la Salud estima que alrededor del 60% de las muertes se producen fuera de los centros de tratamiento, lo que pone de relieve las dificultades para detectar los casos antes de que los pacientes sucumban a la enfermedad. No existen vacunas ni tratamientos aprobados contra el ébola de Bundibugyo, pero se están desarrollando varias vacunas, entre ellas las candidatas de la Universidad de Oxford y la Iniciativa Internacional para la Vacuna contra el Sida (IAVI). Las autoridades congoleñas han comenzado recientemente a vacunar al personal sanitario de primera línea con la vacuna Ervebo de Merck, autorizada contra la subespecie de Zaire del ébola, y de la que se cree que ofrece cierta protección cruzada contra el virus de Bundibugyo.

item.title: EU and some EU states summon Russian embassy officials over Leipzig drone attack
item.description: The European Union and several individual member states have summoned Russian embassy officials over an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport last month, officials said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Union and several individual member states have summoned Russian embassy officials over an attempted drone attack at [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Leipzig/Halle Airport"] last month, officials said on Wednesday. [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Germany"] said on Tuesday it had concluded that Russia was responsible for the incident and ordered a series of measures, including the closure of a consulate and a Russian cultural centre in Berlin. Russia has said it has seen no evidence to support Berlin's accusations and that it will respond. EU foreign chief Kaja Kallas said at a meeting of EU foreign ministers in Ireland on Wednesday that the EU's diplomatic service had summoned the Russian ambassador in Brussels over the incident. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said he had summoned the Russian charge d'affaires in Paris to protest, and that sanctions should be taken at a European level, notably against Russia's shadow fleet. Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen said the incident in Leipzig was completely unacceptable and that he had summoned the Russian ambassador to the Netherlands. Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot said on X on Tuesday that he had summoned the Russian ambassador to Belgium. "This attack comes in addition to a long series of unacceptable incursions on the territory of other EU and NATO Allies in the past months," he said. Russia's ambassador to Germany was summoned on Tuesday. Responding to Germany's announcement, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said Moscow would respond to what she called Berlin's "anti-Russian action," according to Interfax news agency. She gave no further details. The Russian Embassy in Berlin had previously dismissed such accusations as "fabricated provocation" and as "a new wave of anti-Russian hysteria in Germany."

item.title: Tras 286 días en el mar, un portaaviones estadounidense llega a Tailandia
item.description: El portaaviones "Abraham Lincoln" de la Armada de los Estados Unidos atracó el miércoles en Laem Chabang, Tailandia, tras 286 días en el mar, incluido un prolongado despliegue en Oriente Medio, después de que se publicaran informaciones sobre problemas de salud mental y un deterioro de las condiciones a bordo.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Suen, Chalinee Thirasupa
item.content:encoded: El portaaviones "Abraham Lincoln" de la Armada de los Estados Unidos atracó el miércoles en Laem Chabang, Tailandia, tras 286 días en el mar, incluido un prolongado despliegue en Oriente Medio, después de que se publicaran informaciones sobre problemas de salud mental y un deterioro de las condiciones a bordo. El "Lincoln", con unos 5.000 marineros y marines a bordo, participó en el bloqueo naval estadounidense y en las operaciones de combate de la guerra con Irán. Según los diputados demócratas, estableció un récord moderno de días consecutivos en el mar. Acompañado por otros buques de la Armada de EEUU, la escala en Tailandia —el único socio con el que Estados Unidos tiene un tratado en el sudeste asiático continental— de este portaaviones de propulsión nuclear tendrá como objetivo el descanso y la recuperación, y durará cinco días, según fuentes oficiales tailandesas. El Lincoln fue desplegado en noviembre del año pasado. Normalmente, los despliegues navales duran entre seis y nueve meses, pero pueden prolongarse en épocas de conflicto. LOGROS "HISTÓRICOS" "Nuestra llegada a Laem Chabang brinda a nuestros marineros y marines una merecida oportunidad para descansar y recargar energías", dijo en un comunicado el comandante del Grupo de Ataque del Portaaviones 3, el contralmirante Robert E. Loughran. "Lo que ha logrado este grupo de ataque es verdaderamente histórico. No podría estar más orgulloso de la excepcional profesionalidad y experiencia demostradas por cada miembro de este equipo durante nuestras operaciones". Tailandia se convirtió en aliada de Estados Unidos por tratado en 1954, antes de ser designada aliada importante no perteneciente a la OTAN en 2003. Las fuerzas armadas de ambos países mantienen sólidas relaciones y realizan ejercicios conjuntos anuales. Bangkok dejó claro que la visita no guarda relación con el conflicto en Oriente Medio y que la escala en el puerto tiene como objetivo el descanso, la recuperación y la logística, de acuerdo con los compromisos del tratado. El Lincoln, con su amplia cubierta de vuelo repleta de helicópteros y aviones de combate, incluidos los últimos cazas F-35, llegó a Laem Chabang a primera hora del miércoles. El destructor lanzamisiles USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. atracó en Sri Racha, a unos 10 kilómetros de distancia. Ambos buques presentaban manchas de óxido y la pintura descolorida a lo largo de la línea de flotación. A primera hora de la tarde, la tripulación permanecía a bordo. La llegada de miles de militares ha despertado esperanzas de un impulso económico para la cercana ciudad turística de Pattaya, que también es conocida como destino de turismo sexual. Una flota de unos 40 autobuses transportará al personal militar entre Pattaya y el puerto de Laem Chabang, donde atracarán los buques, según el alcalde de Pattaya, Poramase Ngampiches. Pattaya se encuentra en el golfo de Tailandia, a unos 150 kilómetros al sureste de Bangkok. "Hay ciertos lugares y actividades en los que el personal tiene prohibido participar, como todo tipo de deportes acuáticos, paseos en moto acuática, puenting, lucha libre y boxeo", declaró a Reuters. "TOMAR UNAS COPAS, DIVERTIRSE Y DESINHIBIRSE" La policía desplegará patrullas adicionales en los alrededores de la principal zona costera y del barrio de ocio nocturno de Pattaya, tras las redadas llevadas a cabo durante el fin de semana que se saldaron con la detención de entre 40 y 50 personas por sospecha de prostitución, según las autoridades. Aunque es ilegal en Tailandia, la industria del sexo opera abiertamente en los centros turísticos, incluidos Bangkok, Phuket y Pattaya, a pesar de las ocasionales redadas. En vísperas de la llegada del Lincoln, los vendedores ambulantes de Pattaya, cerca de la notoria zona de ocio nocturno "Walking Street", se mostraban ilusionados ante la perspectiva de un aumento de las ventas. "Ha estado todo muy tranquilo estos días", comenta Kadsalin Ketpa, de 43 años, vendedora de ropa, que se había abastecido de camisetas de baloncesto y pantalones con estampado de elefantes antes de la visita al puerto. "Espero que, con su llegada, aumenten mis ventas. He preparado algunos productos para ellos, aunque no sé si les gustarán". Saroch, de 45 años, vendedor de comida, afirma que las visitas al puerto del ejército estadounidense eran buenas para el negocio y siempre algo que se esperaba con ilusión. "Vienen a tomar unas copas, a divertirse y a desinhibirse", dijo Saroch. (1 dólar = 33,3200 baht)

item.title: Wadephul dringt auf neue EU-Sanktionen gegen Russland
item.description: Nach dem versuchten Drohnenangriff auf den Flughafen Leipzig/Halle beraten die EU-Außenminister über weitere Sanktionen gegen Russland. Die Staaten müssten ihre Reaktion auf die Eskalation der russischen Angriffe koordinieren.

Die Staaten müssten ihre Reaktion auf die Eskalation der russischen Angriffe koordinieren. In den kommenden Wochen solle gezielt an der Aufnahme weiterer Personen in die Sanktionsliste gearbeitet werden, sagte Wadephul. Er gehe davon aus, dass "eine große Zahl von Personen" betroffen sein werde. Der Minister betonte zudem die Geschlossenheit der europäischen Staaten und ihrer Partner wie Kanada. Zugleich forderte er eine verstärkte militärische Unterstützung für die Ukraine vor dem Winter, insbesondere bei der Luftverteidigung. Einige EU-Mitgliedstaaten hätten hier noch Reserven, über die nun gesprochen werden müsse. Frankreich bestellte unterdessen wegen des Vorfalls den russischen Geschäftsträger in Paris ein, um zu protestieren. Der französische Außenminister Jean-Noël Barrot forderte zudem EU-Sanktionen gegen die russische Schattenflotte. Auch die finnische Außenministerin Elina Valtonen kündigte an, den russischen Botschafter in Helsinki einzubestellen. Die Bundesregierung macht Russland für den Angriffsversuch Anfang August verantwortlich. Als Reaktion hatte Berlin am Dienstag unter anderem die Schließung des russischen Konsulats in Bonn sowie des Russischen Hauses in Berlin angeordnet.

item.content:encoded: Das DIW-Institut blickt mit mehr Zuversicht auf die Konjunktur in Deutschland und erhöht seine Wachstumsprognose deutlich. Nach einer starken ersten Jahreshälfte dürfte die Wirtschaft 2026 um 1,2 Prozent wachsen und 2027 um 1,0 Prozent zulegen, erklärte das Deutsche Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung (DIW Berlin) am Mittwoch zu seiner Herbstschätzung. "Die deutsche Wirtschaft erholt sich in diesem Jahr etwas besser als gedacht, steht aber noch immer auf etwas wackligen Beinen", sagte DIW-Konjunkturchefin Geraldine Dany-Knedlik. 2028 dürfte das Bruttoinlandsprodukt um weitere 0,7 Prozent zulegen. Im Juni hatte das DIW seine Prognose für das laufende Jahr noch auf [USN:L8N42I0BF TEXT:"0,5 Prozent Wachstum"] halbiert und für 2027 ein BIP-Plus von 0,8 Prozent erwartet. Ausschlaggebend für die aktuelle Aufwärtsrevision waren vor allem der im Frühsommer unerwartet kräftige Außenhandel und dass der Energiepreisschock infolge des Iran-Kriegs geringer ausfiel als zunächst befürchtet, wie die Berliner Ökonomen betonten. "Dennoch bleiben die Aussichten gedämpft." Für das laufende Sommer-Quartal erwarten die Regierungsberater nur eine Stagnation - auch wegen der negativen Folgen für die Industrie durch das Niedrigwasser etwa des Rheins. Hohe Gaspreise, strukturelle Probleme der Industrie und die schwache private Binnennachfrage bremsten die Konjunktur. "Wichtigster Wachstumstreiber bleiben die Investitionen des Staates, vor allem in Form des Sondervermögens für Klimaschutz und Infrastruktur und der Verteidigungsausgaben." MÖGLICHE TRENDWENDE ZU MEHR WACHSTUM Rund 70 Prozent des Wirtschaftswachstums in diesem Jahr gingen auf öffentlichen Konsum und Investitionen zurück, erklärte DIW-Präsident Marcel Fratzscher. Neben steigenden Ausgaben für Gesundheit, Pflege und Rente sorgten höhere Investitionen in Infrastruktur und Verteidigungsausgaben für Schwung. "Die deutsche Wirtschaft steht vor einer möglichen Trendwende zu stärkerem Wachstum in den kommenden zwei Jahren", betonte Fratzscher. "Derzeit verdankt die Konjunktur ihre Dynamik vor allem der öffentlichen Hand." Die größte Schwachstelle bleibe hingegen die private Binnennachfrage. "Die privaten Investitionen reichen weiter nicht aus, um die Wettbewerbs- und Innovationsfähigkeit Deutschlands nachhaltig zu stärken", mahnte Fratzscher. Trotz besserer Konjunkturaussichten sei Vorsicht geboten und globale Unsicherheiten blieben erheblich. "Eine Eskalation im Nahen Osten oder neue Handelskonflikte könnten die Erholung erneut bremsen." Der DIW-Chef betonte aber: "Dennoch gibt es Anlass zu vorsichtigem Optimismus, dass eine nachhaltige Erholung nach mehreren Anläufen nicht erneut ausbleibt." Im zweiten Quartal war die deutsche Wirtschaft um 0,3 Prozent gewachsen, nach einem Plus von 0,4 Prozent zum Jahresstart 2026.

item.title: Hong Kong court rejects lawyer's request to use Evergrande founder's funds for legal costs
item.description: Hong Kong's High Court on Wednesday rejected a request from the lawyer for the founder of embattled Chinese property company Evergrande to use funds controlled by liquidators to pay HK$1.2 million ($153,039) in legal costs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hong Kong's High Court on Wednesday rejected a request from the lawyer for the founder of embattled Chinese property company Evergrande to use funds controlled by liquidators to pay HK$1.2 million ($153,039) in legal costs. The liquidators, who have also been appointed by the court as receivers of founder Hui Ka Yan's personal assets, have been battling to claw back $6 billion in dividends and remuneration paid to him and other ex-executives. Evergrande, which was once China's top property developer, has defaulted on most of its $300 billion in liabilities. The company has become a poster child of the [USN:L4N44I0A5 TEXT:"crisis"] in China's property sector that has long been a drag on the world's second-largest economy. Last week, 67-year-old Hui, who was once Asia's richest man, was [USN:L1N44H03M TEXT:"sentenced"] to life in prison by a Chinese court, which also ordered all his personal property to be confiscated. Hui's lawyer told the Hong Kong court on Wednesday that Hui's legal team did not have access to the full Chinese judgement, adding that she did not know how the confiscation would interact with the Hong Kong proceeding. The lawyer added that Hui has been prohibited by authorities from discussing his assets. After the sentence in China was handed down, offshore creditors were concerned that the confiscation of his personal assets would affect their debt recovery as it could complicate the liquidation process. But Xinpeng Zhu, a lawyer at Shanghai Rongying Law Firm, said he expected the impact to be limited. He said confiscations usually include offshore assets, but creditors' rights would be protected and they rank above criminal fines in liquidations. The Hong Kong High Court ordered Evergrande to liquidate in 2024 and appointed Edward Middleton and Tiffany Wong of Alvarez & Marsal as liquidators. Separately, the liquidators are also [USN:L1N44N09Z TEXT:"seeking"] 57 billion yuan ($8.5 billion) in damages from PwC, accusing the firm of being negligent in its auditing work. Da keine Partei mit der Rechtsaußen-Partei AfD koalieren möchte, könnte laut dieser Umfrage Ministerpräsidentin Schwesig im Amt bleiben. Eine Koalition mit der Linken und der CDU ist wegen des Unvereinbarkeitsbeschlusses der CDU unwahrscheinlich - die CDU lehnt Koalitionen sowohl mit der AfD wie auch mit der Linken ab. Eventuell könnte es für eine Mehrheit von SPD, Linken und Grünen reichen. Oder aber Schwesig könnte eine Minderheitsregierung bilden und wie Sachsens Ministerpräsident Michael Kretschmer (CDU) auf die Unterstützung anderer Parteien in Einzelfragen setzen.

item.title: EU court rejects NGO challenge to bloc's 2023 to 2030 emissions allocations
item.description: Europe's General Court on Wednesday rejected a challenge by NGOs Global Legal Action Network and CAN Europe to a European Commission decision setting EU member states' annual greenhouse gas emission allocations for 2023 to 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Europe's General Court on Wednesday rejected a challenge by NGOs Global Legal Action Network and CAN Europe to a European Commission decision setting EU member states' annual greenhouse gas emission allocations for 2023 to 2030. The NGOs had sought an internal review, arguing the allocations were based on emissions-reduction targets that were insufficient under EU and international law, including the Paris Agreement, and on a flawed impact assessment. The EU's second-highest court upheld the Commission's refusal to conduct the review.

item.title: How Japan's bond rout is turning the tide of global capital
item.description: Bond dealers and asset managers have noticed the pullback of Japan's demand.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift, Harry Robertson
item.content:encoded: With benchmark Japanese bond yields breaking through a three-decade-old barrier, higher returns are starting to tease capital home, reversing what was once a dependable flow of funds into global bond markets. The 3% threshold is significant not just for funding costs in Tokyo, but for turning around an investment flow that has made Japan the biggest owner of U.S. Treasuries and one of the most reliable buyers of sovereign debt worldwide. As the global bond [USN:L1N44T09D TEXT:"rout"] deepened on Wednesday, traders said part of the move rested on bets Japanese investors would retreat from overseas holdings. While there's no sign of Japan dumping its $2.4 trillion hoard in overseas debt just yet, global fund managers and a growing body of data is showing a steadier drawdown is underway. In Sydney, London and Singapore, bond dealers and asset managers have noticed the pullback of Japan's demand. Official data shows Japanese investors have already sold a net 3 trillion yen ($18.7 billion) in overseas debt through August 22, the biggest year-to-date outflow since bonds tanked in 2022. "I know it first hand from talking to Japanese investors," said Michael Weidner, co-head of global fixed income at Lazard Asset Management. "They've underinvested in yen securities for probably 25 years. Now it's become more attractive and they are reallocating." Toshinobu Chiba, a Tokyo-based fund manager at Simplex Asset Management, is one of those investors, saying he's gone bearish on U.S. Treasuries and started buying the 10-year Japanese government bond just before its recent peak in yield. "It's easy to buy the 10-year at above 3%," said Chiba. "Most of the lifers have a strong incentive to buy right now. It's a natural movement for Japanese investors to pull money out of the U.S. and back into Japan." In Australia, a country in which Japanese investors were once the largest foreign holder of debt in pre-pandemic years, market participants are feeling a shift from buying to holding. "This year (Japanese investors) have been less on accumulation and more holding their exposures reasonably consistent," said Ryan Ellis, Citi's head of markets sales for Australia and New Zealand. "They've got a home market bias for the first time in a lot of years," he said, and the Aussie market has been under pressure from central bank rate hikes. "It's very much a return-driven decision," he said. PENSION SHIFTS Global debt markets shuddered in July when Japan floated the possibility of a pivot by its [USN:L1N43J08K TEXT:"Government Pension Investment Fund"] to domestic assets. While there are no signs the $1.8 trillion behemoth is adjusting its portfolio, other Japanese institutional funds are reassessing opportunities at home. A survey of 82 corporate Japanese pension funds by J.P. Morgan Asset Management released on Wednesday showed the net share planning to boost domestic bond holdings was the highest since the poll began in 2008. The funds continued to reduce their holdings of overseas debt amid high currency hedging costs, the survey showed. Such shifts matter because Japanese investors are major players in markets from U.S. Treasuries to French and Australian debt. "As JGB yields rise, the relative attractiveness of domestic bonds improves on a currency-hedged basis, potentially encouraging a shift from overseas assets back into Japanese fixed income," Masayuki Nakajima, senior strategist at Mizuho Bank in London, said in a note. The 10-year JGB yield hit 3% on Tuesday for the first time since 1996, having more than tripled over the past two years. Over the same period 10-year U.S. Treasury yields have climbed about a percentage point and the gap between the two has narrowed by more than 100 basis points. "As you see Japanese bond yields rise ... all of a sudden, the marginal buyer for Treasuries and international bonds is reducing," said Justin Onuekwusi, chief investment officer at St. James's Place in London. "Because ultimately the relative value now between Japanese bonds and international bonds is less, and that bit really is actually quite important." HAWKISH BOJ Less clear cut are the foreign exchange implications, given overseas positions are often hedged. The fact yields have yet to stabilise in Japan is also holding off some buying. Turning the fortunes of Japan's sliding yen will require the central bank, which meets later this month to hike "more rapidly than what markets expect," said Kevin Thozet, member of the investment committee of Paris-based asset manager Carmignac. JGB yields have also been driven up in part by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's push for big fiscal spending. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama on Wednesday again [USN:L4N44T100 TEXT:"declined"] to comment on the 3% threshold, beyond reiterating a commitment to appropriate debt management and saying government budget requests were at reasonable levels. Overseas positions by major Japanese investors that took decades to accumulate also won't turn on a dime. But in a world where all the major borrowers are overextended and currency risks are rising, home more than ever in recent memory is looking like a better option than chasing yields overseas. "The story is not large-scale repatriation, but Japan gradually ceasing to be the marginal buyer of foreign bonds," said Masahiko Loo, senior fixed income strategist at State Street Investment Management in Tokyo. "Less incremental demand from one of the world's largest pools of savings is helping push term premium higher globally." ($1 = 160.2800 yen)

item.title: EU to work on further sanctions against Russian individuals, Germany says

item.content:encoded: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said on Wednesday that the European Union will work on imposing further sanctions on Russian individuals in the coming weeks. item.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak kills more than 3,000, government figures show
item.description: The number of deaths in Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 3,000, government data showed on Wednesday, as the country's worst-ever epidemic continues to spread across its northeast.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The number of deaths in Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 3,000, government data showed on Wednesday, as the country's worst-ever epidemic continues to spread across its northeast. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, became the [USN:L8N43X0QI TEXT:"largest"] and [USN:L6N44D06Y TEXT:"deadliest"] in Congo's history after surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic. It is now second only to the 2014-2016 West African outbreak, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Government figures showed the death toll had risen to 3,007, while confirmed cases reached 6,186. The outbreak was formally declared in Ituri province on May 15, though some health officials and experts say it may have started as early as [USN:L8N43X1UG TEXT:"January"]. It has since spread to six provinces, despite efforts by Congolese authorities, the World Health Organisation and aid groups to contain it. Health experts say [USN:L6N43Q0MR TEXT:"weak surveillance systems"], insecurity and community resistance have [USN:L6N44E0K6 TEXT:"hampered efforts"] to identify and treat patients early. The World Health Organisation estimates that around 60% of deaths happen outside treatment centres, highlighting the challenges of detecting cases before patients succumb to the disease. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or treatments, but several vaccines are under development, including candidates from the University of Oxford and the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI). Congolese authorities recently [USN:L6N44P0IE TEXT:"began vaccinating"] frontline health workers with Merck's Ervebo vaccine, which is licensed against the Zaire species of Ebola, and is believed to offer some cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

HIP, con sede en Barcelona, posee una cartera de 61 hoteles y 20.000 habitaciones repartidas por España, Grecia, Italia y Portugal, cuya valoración, según Cinco Días, ronda los 6.000 millones de euros (6.940 millones de dólares). Blackstone se dispone a presentar la solicitud ante la CNMV, el regulador del mercado de valores español, a principios de octubre, añadió el periódico. Según Cinco Días, Blackstone tiene como objetivo deshacerse de su participación del 65% en la empresa. Blackstone también prevé llevar a cabo una ampliación de capital de 700 millones de euros con motivo de la salida a bolsa, según el periódico. El fondo soberano de Singapur, GIC, es propietario del resto de la empresa. El proceso cuenta con el respaldo de Santander, Morgan Stanley, Citi, BNP Paribas y Goldman Sachs, entre otros, según Cinco Días. HIP, que se dedica a la adquisición, reposicionamiento y gestión de hoteles, no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Tampoco lo hicieron el GIC de Singapur ni Blackstone. Blackstone adquirió HIP al Banco Sabadell (SABE.MC) en 2017. (1 dólar = 0,8646 euros)

item.title: Opera loses court challenge against EU exemption of Microsoft's Edge from DMA rules
item.description: Norwegian browser maker Opera on Wednesday lost its court challenge against EU antitrust regulators' decision to exempt Microsoft's browser Edge from rules reining in the power of Big Tech.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo, Sudip Kar-Gupta
item.content:encoded: Norwegian browser maker Opera (OPRA.O) on Wednesday lost its court challenge against EU antitrust regulators' decision to exempt Microsoft's (MSFT.O) browser Edge from rules reining in the power of Big Tech. The European Commission in its 2024 decision said Edge was not an important gateway for businesses to reach users even though it met the quantitative criteria set out under the Digital Markets Act which sets out a list of dos and don'ts for Big Tech. Opera argued that the Commission, which acts as the EU competition enforcer, had misapplied the criteria. The Luxembourg-based General Court sided with the EU antitrust watchdog which has notched a string of court victories over its DMA decisions, raising the bar for legal challenges. "The General Court upholds the Commission's decision not to designate Microsoft as a gatekeeper in relation to Edge," judges said. They said the EU enforcer did not err by accepting Microsoft's 'sufficiently substantiated arguments to demonstrate that Edge did not constitute an important gateway'. Opera has long been at loggerheads with Microsoft. Its [USN:TRE58R30F TEXT:"2007 complaint"] about its U.S. rival led to a €561 million [USN:BRE925005 TEXT:"EU antitrust fine"] against Microsoft in 2013 for failing to offer users a choice of Web browser. The case is T-357/24 Opera Norway v Commission.

item.title: Las bolsas europeas se mantienen en mínimo de un mes tras repunte de rendimientos y petróleo
item.description: Las bolsas europeas se mantenían el miércoles cerca de su mínimo de un mes, presionadas por un repunte de los rendimientos de los bonos, debido a que la escalada de tensiones en Oriente Medio avivó los temores sobre la inflación provocada por los precios de la energía.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas se mantenían el miércoles cerca de su mínimo de un mes, presionadas por un repunte de los rendimientos de los bonos, debido a que la escalada de tensiones en Oriente Medio avivó los temores sobre la inflación provocada por los precios de la energía. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) se mantenía estable en 647,87 puntos a las 0714 GMT, mientras que el DAX alemán (.GDAXI) bajaba un 0,2%. Estados Unidos e Irán volvieron esta semana a estar en pie de guerra, lo que impulsó los precios del crudo Brent por encima de los 95 dólares el barril, hasta su máximo en seis semanas, y avivó los temores de inflación en un contexto de elevada deuda pública. El rendimiento de los bonos alemanes a 10 años alcanzó su nivel más alto desde abril de 2011, mientras que los inversionistas estiman que hay casi un 40% de probabilidades de que la tasa de depósito del Banco Central Europeo alcance el 3% en marzo de 2027, frente al 25% de la semana pasada, según datos recopilados por LSEG. Entre los valores individuales, Lottomatica (LTMC.MI) caía un 6,3% y su cotización se suspendió temporalmente después de que la empresa italiana de apuestas anunciara que absorberá la española Cirsa (CIRSA.MC) para crear una entidad combinada. El sector de los medios de comunicación (.SXMP) perdía un 1,5% y lideraba las caídas. Los valores del sector de las telecomunicaciones (.SXKP) lideraban las subidas, con Nokia Oyj (NOKIA.HE) subiendo casi un 2% después de que el proveedor de índices STOXX anunciara que el fabricante finlandés de equipos de telecomunicaciones volverá a formar parte del Euro STOXX 50.

item.title: Dinamarca envía reclutas a Groenlandia ante el aumento de las tensiones en el Ártico
item.description: Dinamarca desplegó reclutas en Groenlandia por primera vez en la historia reciente, en un momento en que el país se dispone a reforzar su presencia en el Ártico tras las exigencias de Estados Unidos de adquirir dicho territorio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dinamarca desplegó reclutas en Groenlandia por primera vez en la historia reciente, en un momento en que el país se dispone a reforzar su presencia en el Ártico tras las exigencias de Estados Unidos de adquirir dicho territorio. El presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, ha intentado en repetidas ocasiones hacerse con el control de esta isla danesa semiautónoma, alegando motivos de seguridad nacional y acusando a Copenhague de descuidar la defensa del Ártico. Dinamarca y Groenlandia han rechazado rotundamente la propuesta. Los reclutas forman parte de la primera promoción del nuevo programa danés de servicio militar obligatorio ampliado, cuyo objetivo es formar soldados capaces de operar en una de las regiones más importantes desde el punto de vista estratégico y más difíciles del reino. "Demuestra que estamos aquí y que no solo pensamos en nuestro propio bienestar, sino también en la gente de Groenlandia", dijo a Reuters David, un recluta de 19 años. Copenhague ha prometido miles de millones de dólares para reforzar las defensas del Ártico después de que el ministro de Defensa danés reconociera años de falta de inversión en la región. "Por supuesto, formamos parte de un panorama más amplio de comunicación estratégica sobre Groenlandia, pero nuestro papel aquí se limita a continuar con el entrenamiento de los reclutas y los soldados, y a adquirir más experiencia con el entrenamiento en el terreno y el clima árticos", dijo la capitana Laura Jepsen, comandante de la compañía. Los reclutas participan en "Arctic Endurance", un ejercicio militar danés que entrena a los soldados para el combate y la supervivencia en condiciones de frío extremo. El ejercicio forma parte de "Arctic Sentry", una misión de la OTAN puesta en marcha este año para reforzar la presencia de la alianza en el Ártico y aliviar las tensiones dentro de la OTAN tras las declaraciones de Trump sobre Groenlandia. Rusia, que mantiene la mayor presencia militar del Ártico, ha criticado la creciente actividad de la OTAN en la región, calificándola de amenaza directa para la seguridad que aumenta el riesgo de confrontación. China ha incrementado su actividad en esta región rica en minerales, principalmente en colaboración con Moscú. Durante el entrenamiento al norte del círculo polar ártico, los reclutas se desplazaron por un paisaje de roca desnuda y extensiones abiertas sin árboles a la vista. "Creo que esto transmite el mensaje de que Dinamarca se está reforzando de cara al futuro", dijo Anton, de 22 años, uno de los reclutas. (1 dólar = 6,4472 coronas danesas)
